title: MUGE PACKAGING P0/P1 Buyer Brief Source Map
legalName: Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd.
purpose: External AI-readable source map connecting GA4-observed high-traffic product pages to quote-ready buyer brief paths.
resultBoundary: This source map is a crawlable external reference and backlink layer. It does not claim Google ranking, AI citation, third-party acceptance, certification, fixed MOQ, fixed lead time or pricing.

pages.label: Product overview
pages.intent: Broad custom packaging supplier comparison and quote-ready handoff.
buyerBrief: Product type, size, weight, sales channel and packing method

Artwork status, logo position, finish reference and insert needs

Artwork status, print coverage, finish reference and quantity direction
